with_memory.headline: Multiple prior claims on same vehicle raise concern
with_memory.reasoning: The same vehicle TS08FK4521 appears in two earlier claims (CLM-2026-10522 and CLM-2026-10433) under different policies. Both prior claims were approved, which does not clear the current claim and suggests a pattern of repeated damage reporting on the same asset. While the outcomes were genuine, the recurrence of the same personal identifier warrants deeper investigation.

red_flags.title: Repeated vehicle usage
red_flags.detail: Vehicle TS08FK4521 was used in two earlier claims (CLM-2026-10522, CLM-2026-10433).

mitigating_factors: Both prior claims were approved after standard verification
No confirmed fraud links in history
next_steps: Obtain detailed repair invoices and photos of damage for verification
Cross‑check the vehicle's repair history with the garage records
Confirm the police report status or obtain a FIR if applicable
questions_for_claimant: Can you provide the original registration certificate and service history of the vehicle?
Did you report the incident to the police, and can you share the FIR number?
Has the vehicle been involved in any prior accidents or repairs not previously claimed?

stateless.headline: Claim appears typical with no immediate red flags
